name: SavePerGroup
title: Templates/Platform/Forms/SavePerGroup
summary: A settings page split into topic groups that each save on their own: the platform shell, a page heading, then one section per topic, each a small heading over a flush `Card` of `Item` rows whose footer carries a secondary Save for that group only. Saving one group disables just its own fieldset; the other stays editable. Preferences is the example, with General (Full Name, Language) and Notifications (Product updates, Security alerts). Built from the platform shell, `Card`, `Item`, `Input`, `Select`, `Switch` and `Button`.

variants.name: SavingOneGroup
variants.summary: General is saving: its Save shows the loading state and its rows are disabled, while Notifications stays editable and can be saved on its own.
